rationale: Exact definition, history, replay and target-preparation mechanics are reusable, while inspection defect meaning and preparation transformation meaning remain owned by their products and step contracts.
Recipe compilation reuses graph/type libraries but owns editioned executable-composition meaning; it does not absorb pipeline scheduling, transformation build or operation semantics.
Target transfer/preparation has provider identity, asynchronous completion, capacity, reconciliation and cleanup states absent from pure definition or replay.
